assignment.name: Photosynthesis Lab Report
assignment.description:
What you're doing

You measured oxygen production in Elodea at four light intensities. Write a lab report interpreting your data.

Objectives this assesses

  • Describe how the light-dependent reactions convert light energy into ATP and NADPH.
  • Interpret experimental data on the rate of photosynthesis under varying light conditions.

What to include

  1. Mechanism (about 400 words). Trace energy from photon capture through ATP and NADPH production. Name the products and where each step happens.
  2. Data interpretation (about 400 words). Describe the relationship between light intensity and oxygen production in your data. Identify where the curve levels off and explain what limits the rate there.
  3. A figure. One graph of your data, with axes labeled and units given.

Format

PDF or Word, roughly 800-1000 words plus the figure. Due at the start of Week 4.

0.long_description: Traces energy from photon capture through to ATP and NADPH, naming where each step occurs.

ratings.description: Traces all four steps (photon capture, electron transport, proton gradient, NADP+ reduction) and names both products with their locations
Traces the sequence but omits a step, misnames a product, or places a step in the wrong compartment
Describes photosynthesis in general terms without tracing the light-dependent reactions specifically

1.long_description: Reads the relationship in the student's own data and explains the limiting factor at saturation.

ratings.description: States the relationship, identifies the saturation point from the data, and names a specific limiting factor with justification
States the relationship and notes the curve levels off, but attributes it to no factor or an unjustified one
Restates data points without interpreting the relationship
